title: Tyco Group (ADT Security) - proposed acquisition of Signature Security Group Pty Limited

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: Tyco Group proposed to acquire Signature Group and merge it with its subsidiary ADT Security.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the proposed acquisition within the context of: - state-based markets for the supply of electronic security installation and servicing; and - a national market for the supply of monitoring services for electronic security systems.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the proposed merger was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the relevant markets. Key factors informing this conclusion included: - the presence of a number of existing competitors to the merged entity; and - barriers to entry were not likely to be high.
